import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.00)

# 1. Survival rate by passenger class and sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().reset_index()
survival_pivot = survival_by_class_sex.pivot(index='pclass', columns='sex', values='survived')
x = np.arange(len(survival_pivot.index))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax1.bar(x - width/2, survival_pivot['female'], width, label='Female', color='#FF6B9D', alpha=0.8)
bars2 = ax1.bar(x + width/2, survival_pivot['male'], width, label='Male', color='#4A90E2', alpha=0.8)
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Gender', fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'])
ax1.legend()
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 2. Age distribution by survival
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
survived_ages = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
died_ages = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()
ax2.hist([died_ages, survived_ages], bins=20, label=['Did not survive', 'Survived'], 
         color=['#E74C3C', '#27AE60'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.legend()
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Survival rate by embarkation port
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
embark_survival = df.groupby('embarked')['survived'].agg(['sum', 'count']).reset_index()
embark_survival['rate'] = embark_survival['sum'] / embark_survival['count']
embark_labels = {'S': 'Southampton', 'C': 'Cherbourg', 'Q': 'Queenstown'}
embark_survival['port'] = embark_survival['embarked'].map(embark_labels)
embark_survival = embark_survival.dropna()
colors = ['#3498DB', '#E67E22', '#9B59B6']
bars = ax3.bar(embark_survival['port'], embark_survival['rate'], color=colors, alpha=0.8, edgecolor='black')
ax3.set_xlabel('Port of Embarkation', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 1)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'{height:.2%}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontweight='bold')

# 4. Fare distribution by class with survival overlay
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
for pclass in sorted(df['pclass'].unique()):
    class_data = df[df['pclass'] == pclass]
    survived_fare = class_data[class_data['survived'] == 1]['fare']
    died_fare = class_data[class_data['survived'] == 0]['fare']
    
    ax4.scatter(survived_fare, [pclass] * len(survived_fare), alpha=0.4, 
               label=f'Class {pclass} - Survived' if pclass == 1 else None,
               color='#27AE60', s=30, marker='o')
    ax4.scatter(died_fare, [pclass] * len(died_fare), alpha=0.4,
               label=f'Class {pclass} - Died' if pclass == 1 else None,
               color='#E74C3C', s=30, marker='x')

ax4.set_xlabel('Fare (£)', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Passenger Class', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class and Survival', fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.set_yticks([1, 2, 3])
ax4.set_yticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'])
ax4.legend(['Survived', 'Did not survive'], loc='upper right')
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3)
ax4.set_xlim(-5, 300)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
